cleanRoom.source: Repo-owned Excel/MSForms fixture input generated through public Excel/VBIDE automation and driven with public Windows input.
cleanRoom.prohibited: No Office internals, decompilation, disassembly, non-public source, or OxForms output comparison.

notes: Two TextBoxes, an OK CommandButton, and a Toggle CheckBox laid out non-overlapping so a window-bounds + fixture-layout calculation can target each control by point.

Focus/validation/key event handlers each log the relevant ReturnBoolean/ReturnInteger argument before and after the handler mutated it, plus the post-handler focus owner and the relevant TextBox .Text.

Mutations (Exit veto, BeforeUpdate veto, KeyDown/KeyPress swallow) are gated on Public module flags set by per-scenario Set... macros, so one workbook covers every focus/key fold-back scenario through the shared W008BreadthLog worksheet.
OkButton.Default is set to True at RUNTIME in UserForm_Initialize; control fonts are intentionally not declared/applied (focus/key breadth oracle, not a text-metrics oracle).
